claims.statement: Rodrigo Borgia, father of Cesare Borgia, in whose service Leonardo worked in 1502 and 1503. His death in August 1503 ended Cesare's power.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Standard papal chronologies.
